_about: Public-domain Thomas Sherlock (1678-1761, Master of the Temple, Bishop of Bangor, Salisbury and London) for the Word Hoard: his Works with T. S. Hughes's account of his life (5 vols, London: Valpy, 1830), his collected discourses and sermons (The Trial of the Witnesses of the Resurrection was not found in their OCR and is not claimed), raw Internet Archive OCR. Not his father William Sherlock (c.1641-1707, Dean of St Paul's), also a divine. Added 2026-10-03 by lane A, round 13 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
